title: Consolidate the 'task stops at PR' rule: dashboard uses task-run-facts' function
description:
Repository: JKershaw/LinearViewer (Harbour). One PR. Runs after LIN-3717.

## Why

"Any row of the task declares stopAt 'pr', so the task stops at the PR" is written twice: lib/task-run-facts.js:49 and routes/dashboard.js:1761, a verbatim copy. This ticket gives that one rule one function in Runs, used by both. Light lane, one PR, after LIN-3717. No live outside calls or paid model calls.

## What is true now (origin/main 7ea6d82a; verify at your base)

* LIN-3717 has not landed (lib/run-loop-state.js is absent). It moves code out of routes/dashboard.js, so find the site by text.
* Comparison of `readTaskRunFacts` (task-run-facts.js:38-77) and `readRunFacts` (dashboard.js:1752-1773, one caller, :1409, passing `session.seedIssue`):
  * **Same:** the guard (`!store || !urlKey || !issueIdentifier` gives defaults); the queries (`listItems` then `listHistory` with `(urlKey, { issueIdentifier })`, `.catch`, then `listRows`); row order; the falsy-row skip (`row &&`); the expression `rows.some(row => row && row.stopAt === 'pr') ? 'pr' : null` (so 'merge', null, undefined and missing give null); the variant read; the return shape `{ stopAt, variant }`. The "seed-issue rows" are only the identifier passed in.
  * **Different:** (a) task-run-facts adds the sessionId hop (:53-70, `getItemStatus`, :63): when own rows give no 'pr', it takes `stopAt` from the parent run row. The dashboard has no hop. (b) task-run-facts skips a store method that is not a function; the dashboard calls it unguarded, so a store without `listItems` or `listHistory` throws into its catch and returns the defaults. (c) the log text and the defaults object differ.
* Result: the **aggregation** (row list to 'pr' or null) is the same rule. The **reads** are not. Calling `readTaskRunFacts` from the dashboard would add the hop and the `getItemStatus` reads, so it is not allowed. Only the aggregation is shared.
* Owner: Runs & dispatch (scripts/code-shape/areas.json matches `task-run-facts`). dashboard.js already imports from Runs (`run-closeout-state.js`, :60), so the new import adds no area pair.

## Done when

1. Confirm LIN-3717 is merged (lib/run-loop-state.js at origin/main; `git log origin/main --grep=LIN-3717`). If not, STOP and report on the ticket. Else branch from fresh main.
2. Re-compare the two functions at your base. If the aggregation expressions are no longer the same, or the dashboard has grown a hop or another rule, STOP and report the difference on the ticket. Do not unify two rules.
3. **Free the seam first.** Trace, not grep: run the unit tests with a preload logging every test-side read of routes/dashboard.js and lib/task-run-facts.js. List each location or text pin that would break. Grep leads, which undercount: lin-3124-pr3-checkpoint-c2 (:20), dashboard-routes (:4351), interactive-openrouter-chain-byte-identity (:197), lin-3384-redaction-census (:138, :158). Replace each with a behaviour test before the move: the test lands while the old pin is green; in a scratch copy outside the repo plant a bug, show the test fail, restore, show it pass; only then loosen or delete the pin in a later commit. A pin may be retired only by a behaviour test that fails on a planted bug.
4. Export one function from task-run-facts.js (name open, default `stopAtFromRows(rows)`) holding the expression above. `readTaskRunFacts` :49 and `readRunFacts` :1761 call it. The dashboard builds its rows exactly as today: no hop, no typeof guards. :63 stays.
5. **Behaviour test, old and new.** Run the dashboard path (the session page route, reading the `stopAt` handed to the run-evidence reader) over one row table with old code (an export of the base commit outside the repo) and new code: results identical. Table: stopAt 'pr', 'merge', null, undefined and missing; falsy entries (null, undefined, false, 0) among the rows; mixed rows (pr first, pr last, pr in history only, pr in queue only); history as an array, as `{ items }` and as null; a rejecting `listItems`; a store without `listItems` (dashboard gives the defaults). Run `readTaskRunFacts` over the same table plus hop cases (parent 'pr', null, 'merge', no row), also identical. Plant a mutant (truthy test) in the shared function; both callers' tests must fail.
6. **Knots.** Run `scripts/code-shape/seams.mjs` at base and at every commit on the branch, each commit with its own output, all with the base's unedited areas.json. No pair absent at base may appear at any commit. If one does, move that code back and list it as an open question. No areas.json edit.

## Tests

* tests/unit/task-run-facts.test.js: add the row table and the function's own cases.
* tests/unit/dashboard-routes.test.js, or a new file beside it: the dashboard table, with expected values captured on the base, so it passes before and after.
* Item 3's conversions, in the files the trace names.

## Docs

docs/architecture/source-map.md: the task-run-facts.js entry (:88) names the exported function and says the dashboard shares only the aggregation. CLAUDE.md: nothing (110-line cap).

## Files this touches

lib/task-run-facts.js, routes/dashboard.js, docs/architecture/source-map.md, and the tests above.

## Out of scope

The other eight equality sites: task-run-facts.js:63, dispatch-entrance.js:1648, dispatch-factory.js:385 and :1010, run-closeout-state.js:174, close-out-readiness.js:128, routes/workspace-api.js:3685, prompts/autopilot-kickoff.js:405. Each is a one-token comparison against the field's own vocabulary (dispatch-fields.js:198); wrapping it adds indirection and removes no decision. Also out: the browser sites, a helper for the bare comparison, and giving the dashboard the hop.

## Open questions

Keep today's behaviour, record in the PR, carry on. (1) The function name. (2) Class (d), for a later ruling: the run page has no hop, so a run whose seed issue has only worker rows shows stopAt null where the task page shows 'pr'. Write it up; do not change it.

## Operator notes

**Rules for this run**

* No live calls to outside services (GitHub, Linear, OpenRouter, [harbour.cat](<http://harbour.cat>) or any other live host). Tests use the existing fakes.
* No paid model or OpenRouter calls.
* This is one PR. Don't split it into child tickets.
* No parallel forks or background sub-agents; one part at a time.
* Targeted tests while iterating (`node --test tests/unit/<file>.test.js`). Full unit suite (`npm run test:unit`) once before opening the PR. Leave e2e to CI.
* A failing-then-passing test is the witness for any behaviour change.
* Keep every existing ticket reference and every reason comment beside the code it governs; drop one only if its code is gone, and list those in the PR.
* A new production file (anything outside `tests/` and `docs/`) gets a pattern in `scripts/code-shape/areas.json` for the area that owns it, in the same PR. First match wins there, so check the file lands in that area and not in "Other features": run `node scripts/code-shape/seams.mjs . <commit>` at the base commit and at your final commit, report the area-pair count both times, and give the reason for any new pair. If it cannot run in your checkout (exit 2, `acorn` missing), record it as not run.
* Prompt text (templates, meta-prompt, runner prompt) is size-frozen (`tests/unit/prompt-size-budget.test.js`). If you add prompt text, remove bytes elsewhere or raise the ceiling with the reason recorded beside it (LIN-3633), and say which in the PR.
* Where a choice is still open, keep today's behaviour, write it up as an open question in the PR, and carry on. Never stop to wait for a person. A check that needs a live service or a person is recorded in the PR as not run (what, why, follow-up), not a reason to hold the close.

## Outcome

Implemented as approved: `stopAtFromRows(rows)` in `lib/task-run-facts.js`, used by `readTaskRunFacts` and the run page's `readRunFacts`; PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2008](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2008>) (merge commit 8ddb0f3b). No deviations from the ticket; function name kept as the default. The run-page vs task-page divergence is filed for a ruling as LIN-3725. This description held no implementation-plan, research or design sections to prune (it is the problem statement, acceptance criteria and scope, all kept); the full pre-close description is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

comments.body: PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2008 (commit 3bd12734). `stopAtFromRows(rows)` exported from lib/task-run-facts.js; readTaskRunFacts and the run page readRunFacts both call it; the dashboard read path is otherwise unchanged (no hop, no guards). Tests: full unit suite 18971 pass / 0 fail; dashboard table passes on base and new source; a truthy-test mutant fails 3 tests in task-run-facts and 1 in dashboard-routes. seams.mjs: 61 links at base and HEAD, no new pair. Open: name kept as default; run-page-vs-task-page hop divergence documented, not changed. Not done: the preload trace of test-side reads (the named pins do not match the changed text; suite is green).

## Review — LIN-3722

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2008, head `3bd12734c5b28de03443baa2959c64ee38922eaf` (one commit on base `d10e7398`, which is LIN-3717 merged).

CI: green on 3bd12734 (Tests run 39421062442: Unit tests, E2E 1–4/4, Secret scan, CI success all SUCCESS).

**Scope vs plan.** The diff touches exactly the files the ticket lists: `lib/task-run-facts.js`, `routes/dashboard.js`, `docs/architecture/source-map.md`, and the two named test files. `stopAtFromRows(rows)` holds the same expression byte for byte. `readTaskRunFacts` and the run page's `readRunFacts` both call it. The dashboard read path is otherwise unchanged: no hop, no typeof guards, and `:63` (now `:79`) is still there. No areas.json, prompt or CLAUDE.md change, and no reason comments or ticket refs were dropped.

**Regression check.** `git log -- lib/task-run-facts.js routes/dashboard.js` shows only LIN-3717 since the ticket was written. The PR builds on it and re-applies nothing that was reverted.

**Independent re-runs (on my machine, not the author's numbers)**
- Full `npm run test:unit` at head: 18971 pass, 0 fail.
- The new dashboard table, copied onto the **base** source (d10e7398): 18/18 pass. Before and after give the same results.
- Mutants, each reverted after the run:
  1. Truthy test (`row && row.stopAt`) in `stopAtFromRows`: 4 fail. Three are in task-run-facts (merge in the function table, merge in the readTaskRunFacts table, truthy non-pr values); one is in dashboard-routes (`stopAt for merge row`). Both callers go red.
  2. Falsy-row guard dropped (`row.stopAt === 'pr'`): 4 fail.
  3. The test's stack-sniff seam forced to never match (`isFactsRead = () => false`): 9 of 18 fail, so the seam is really wired into the facts read.
  4. A hop-like lift added to the dashboard (`|| rows.some(r => r.sessionId) ? 'pr'`): the `no sessionId hop` test fails.
- **Preload trace (ticket item 3, which the PR left undone).** I ran it: a `--import` preload logged every `fs` read of `routes/dashboard.js` and `lib/task-run-facts.js` across the full unit suite. 31 test files read one or both. All but two are repo-wide scanners such as censuses, import boundaries and the secret scan. Only two pin text near this change. `dashboard-routes.test.js` reads source only at :4351 (the run-paragraph import ban). `lin-3384-redaction-census` counts store-reader calls per function: `readRunFacts: 2`, `readTaskRunFacts: 3`. `stopAtFromRows` makes no store read, so those counts are correct and unchanged. No pin pins the moved expression, so none needed converting or retiring. Item 3 is satisfied.
- **Seams** (`seams.mjs`, the base's unedited areas.json): exit 0 at d10e7398 and at 3bd12734. The only diff is one more importer of `lib/task-run-facts.js` from Web routes into Runs & dispatch (imports 44→45). That pair already existed, so no new pair.

**Isolated, or one of a class?** I ran `git grep "stopAt.{0,6}'pr'"` over lib/routes/prompts/public. The only "rows → any 'pr'" aggregations were these two, and both now use the one function. The rest are the eight single-token comparisons the ticket ruled out of scope, plus `workspace-api.js:1054` (query-param validation, not an aggregation). This change is isolated.

**Nit (no change needed).** The dashboard test tells the facts read apart from the session point-read with `/readRunFacts/.test(new Error().stack)`. Renaming `readRunFacts` would turn it red loudly (mutant 3), not leave it silently green, so it is acceptable.

**Outside scope, already written up in the PR, not a ledger item.** Open question (2): a run whose seed issue has only worker rows shows stopAt `null` on the run page and `'pr'` on the task page. A store without `listItems` gives defaults on the run page but is skipped on the task page. The ticket says to record this for a later ruling and not change it. Close-out can file it for that ruling if no ticket exists yet. Open question (1): the default name `stopAtFromRows` was kept.

### What CI Did Not Prove
CI covers the deliverable; ledger empty. This is a pure refactor and its behaviour is pinned on both callers by route-level and unit tables that pass on base and head and fail under mutants. The one claim CI never ran, the preload trace, was run in this review (above): discharged.

### Verdict
Approve. The shared rule is one function, both callers use it, behaviour is the same as base, the trace found no stale pins, and no new seam pair appeared.

## Close-out — LIN-3722

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2008, squash-merged to main as `8ddb0f3b09d01e3a9e2ce01c7c919a885bf9ba57`, pinned with `--match-head-commit 3bd12734c5b28de03443baa2959c64ee38922eaf` (the reviewed head). `stopAtFromRows(rows)` is exported from `lib/task-run-facts.js`; `readTaskRunFacts` and the run page's `readRunFacts` both call it. I confirmed on main after the merge that the export and its call site (`lib/task-run-facts.js:39`, `:65`) are present.

**Review verdict:** Approve, with an empty ledger ("CI covers the deliverable; ledger empty"; the preload trace the PR left undone was run and discharged in review).

**Changes I made after approval:** none. Review asked for no fixes, so nothing was added to the reviewed commit.

**Ledger:** empty, nothing to settle. Review's one item outside the ledger, the run-page vs task-page divergence (open question 2), is filed as LIN-3725 (see below).

**CI:** fresh read before the merge: all checks SUCCESS on 3bd12734 (Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4/4, Secret scan, CI success), PR mergeable. CI exists, so no substitute was needed.

**Post-deploy:** the ticket asks for no post-deploy step. The behaviour is pinned by the route-level and unit tables that pass on base and head and fail under mutants (per review). I did not run a live check of a deployed Harbour or read its footer commit: not run, because it is a pure refactor with no runtime behaviour change, and nothing could run it that CI has not already covered.

**Follow-up filed:** LIN-3725, "Ruling: should the run page follow the sessionId hop for stopAt, as the task page does?" Priority Low (display difference on one page for an edge class of runs, no writes), labels Improvement + kind:decision, related to this ticket. I searched for an existing ticket on the same finding, found none, and the rulings list for LIN-3722 was empty.

**Open question 1 (name):** `stopAtFromRows` kept as the default.

**Archive & prune:** see the next comment.

Archive & prune: pre-prune snapshot confirmed in /snapshots (description identical to the pre-close text). The description has no plan/research/design sections to remove, so nothing was pruned; I appended a short Outcome stub (what landed, PR link, no deviations, history in snapshots and comments).
